🔍 Description
The Marketplace Update for [Insert Date] is here, and this week brings some truly must‑have aircraft experiences — including new B747 British Airways missions and a beautifully themed A320 Brussels Trident pack. Let’s take a look at everything new for PC simmers!

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: ABOVE THE SKY MASTER COLLECTION VOL. 02 (Collection of discovery-style missions)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: ADVANCED LANDINGS MASTER COLLECTION – 02 (Landing challenge bundle)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – EHAM [Winter 2025] (Amsterdam seasonal operations)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – FACT [Winter 2025] (Cape Town seasonal operations)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – KDFW [Winter 2025] (Dallas/Fort Worth seasonal operations)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – SAEZ [Winter 2025] (Buenos Aires seasonal operations)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: Airport Schedules – ZGGG [Winter 2025] (Guangzhou seasonal operations)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: 4AIR MISSIONS – B747 BRITISH AIRWAYS (Iconic 747 mission pack)
🗺️ Perfect Flight: A320 Captain – Brussels Trident (Belgian-themed A320 experience)
🗺️ Koschi: Jerrie Mock’s flight around the world (Historic world‑tour recreation)

If you’re enjoying these Marketplace breakdowns each week, make sure to hit that like button, subscribe for more MSFS updates, and let me know in the comments which activity you plan to try first!
Thanks for watching and supporting the channel — it truly means a lot.

✈️ See you in the skies!
